registration.statement: The admitted two-hand relativistic closure forces the exact positive three-motion share 3/5. A confined rotating tube has the two forced Fold hands, so one spin successor retains one motion share on each hand and adds 2(3/5)=6/5 squared-support units. The first positive spin rank carries the unsucceeded 3/5 motion share. Therefore every positive rank is forced depth-independently as Q(J)=3/5+(J-1)6/5=(6J-3)/5. No slope, intercept, resonance mass, width or residual is fitted or available to the formal execution.
